name: nikhilkulkarni1755-site
description: Query Nikhil Kulkarni's engineering work — technical writing, projects and the tech behind each, merged open-source contributions to vLLM and SGLang, and his resume. Read-only, unauthenticated.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Nikhil Kulkarni's site
tools.description: Full-text search across every page and blog post on nikhilkulkarni1755.com — technical writing, project write-ups, the resume page and engineering take-homes. Returns ranked matches with a snippet; pass an id to `fetch` for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a page or post in full
tools.description: Retrieve the complete text of one page or blog post as markdown. Accepts an id from `search` (e.g. "blog-matmul-to-ai") or a site route (e.g. "/about").

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects and the tech behind each
tools.description: Every project Nikhil has built, with its description, tech stack, and links to source, demos or the live deployment. Optionally filter by technology.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Explain one project in depth
tools.description: One project in full, plus the pages and posts that discuss it. Use this to answer "what is Iridium?" or to go deeper on anything `list_projects` returned.

name.description: Project name, e.g. "Iridium" or "vLLM on EKS".

tools.name: get_open_source_contributions
tools.title: Summarise open-source contributions
tools.description: Merged contributions to open-source inference and agent infrastructure — vLLM, SGLang and ax-agent-studio — with what each change did and a link to the pull requests.

tools.name: get_resume
tools.title: Get experience, education and skills
tools.description: Structured professional history: roles and what was delivered in each, education, skills by area, and certifications.
